interaction.trigger: Scroll main practice pane from 0 to 96 pixels and beyond

source.representation: 60 pixel source art and full-size title in song header

target.representation: 40.8 pixel art and 86 percent title in same sticky header

facets.label: Active source thumbnail or fallback icon

relationships.label: Exact active reference or linked take

workingState.label: One source, clock, paused/playing state and saved stem levels

controls.label: Readable controls and labels independent of waveform brightness

paths.forward: One sticky header contracts its real layout at scroll96, preserving existing title/artwork/control nodes and reclaiming viewport height.
paths.reverse: Below scroll24 the same nodes return to expanded layout.
paths.interruption: Scroll thresholds use hysteresis to avoid resize-induced oscillation.
paths.fallback: Without a main scroll pane the unscaled identity remains a static header; missing or failed artwork becomes existing song icon.
paths.reducedMotion: Same compact/expanded layout applies immediately without timed transitions.

identity.commitment: Song and exact active source remain the same.

spatial.commitment: Artwork/title share stable header anchors; score gains usable viewport area when header contracts.

context.commitment: Back, song tabs and source relation stay visible.

state.commitment: Scroll, focus, current source clock and saved gain survive.

control.commitment: Same native buttons and readable mixer remain mounted.

task.commitment: Follow the passage while knowing the song and effective instrument balance.

checkpoints.start: One 60 pixel artwork and title at scroll zero.
checkpoints.midpoint: Below compact threshold header remains expanded with same mounted nodes.
checkpoints.settled: At scroll96+ header height decreases by at least30px; visible timeline area increases.
checkpoints.reverse: Below scroll24 restores expanded height and original nodes.
checkpoints.interrupted: Rapid180 to0 retains same header/media owner and restores expanded layout.
checkpoints.fallback: Failed image dispatch shows icon without losing the header.
checkpoints.reducedMotion: Same contracted height without timed transitions.
